title: HARQ / MAC fault angles on NR RRC setup failure

k1_configuration.summary: K1 is the PDSCH-to-HARQ-ACK timing indicator in DL DCI (harq_feedback_timing / PDSCH-to-HARQ_feedback). RRC dl-DataToUL-ACK lists allowed slot offsets; DCI picks the row index.
k1_configuration.dci_field: PDSCH-to-HARQ_feedback timing indicator (3 bits in DCI 1_0 → row index into dl-DataToUL-ACK)
k1_configuration.rrc_fail_link: Msg4 contention resolution and RRC Setup PDSCH require UE HARQ-ACK on PUCCH. Wrong K1 → ACK on wrong slot → gNB treats Msg4/RRC Setup as failed → setup timeout or re-RACH.
checks: Log: harq_feedback_timing= or k1= on PDCCH before RRC Setup PDSCH
Verify dl-DataToUL-ACK table in SIB1/RRCSetup matches DCI K1 index
PUCCH resource indicator + K1 consistent with active BWP SCS
TS 38.213 §9.2.3 minimum time between last PDSCH symbol and PUCCH
k1_configuration.note_rar: DCI 1_0 with RA-RNTI has no K1 — gNB does not expect HARQ-ACK for Msg2 RAR (TS 38.213 §8.2).

redundancy_version.summary: RV selects which bits are transmitted from the HARQ circular buffer after rate matching. Receiver soft-combines retransmissions.
redundancy_version.dci_field: Redundancy version (2 bits) per transport block
redundancy_version.table_ref: TS 38.212 Table 5.4.2.1-2 — starting position per RV
redundancy_version.rrc_fail_link: Msg4 or RRC Setup PDSCH CRC fail → RV retx loop. Persistent NACK with rv_idx cycling then stall looks like RRC setup failure.
checks: Log: rv_idx=0/1/2/3 on PDSCH carrying Msg4 or RRC Setup
crc=NOK / retx count before giving up
BLER on setup PDSCH vs RF (RSRP/SINR) — rule out pure RF vs config

harq_processor.summary: NR uses asynchronous HARQ on DL and UL. DCI carries HARQ process number (4 bits); up to 16 DL processes via RRC.
harq_processor.rrc_ie: nrofHARQ-ProcessesForPDSCH in PDSCH-ServingCellConfig (n2, n4, n6, n10, n12, n16; default 8 if absent)
harq_processor.hybrid_note: Hybrid = FEC (LDPC) + ARQ with soft combining at MAC — corrupted TB stored, RV retx adds LLR.
harq_processor.rrc_fail_link: RACH + contention + RRC Setup may all use process 0 in logs; process exhaustion or ID mismatch rare at setup but visible in parallel traffic cases.
checks: Log: harq_process= or harq= on Msg3/Msg4/RRC Setup PDSCH
Compare nrofHARQ-ProcessesForPDSCH in cell config vs lab expectation
Async: retx order may differ from initial TX slot

frame_structure.summary: Slot/symbol layout (SCS, TDD pattern, PDSCH mapping) determines valid K0/K1/K2 and RACH occasions.
frame_structure.rrc_fail_link: K1 must fit within active DL/UL pattern. TDD DL-heavy or short PUCCH window → ACK miss during setup.
checks: Cell SCS and TDD UL/DL pattern vs PRACH/RAR window
Msg3 K2 (PUSCH after RAR) from pusch-TimeDomainAllocationList
Symbol allocation: PDSCH @ symb=1:13 then PUCCH K1 slots later
